name: Countdown Standing Calendar With Tray
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Made from a combination of acrylic (3 mm) and wood (3–5 mm) for durability and a refined look.
    The calendar tree features three layers:
    - Layer 1: Clear acrylic (3 mm) for a sleek and glossy finish.
    - Layers 2 & 3: Wooden panels (3 mm) with natural grain texture.
    Base & Storage Tray: Wooden construction (5 mm thick), sturdy and long-lasting.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions:
    - Tree Calendar Height: 10 x 10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
    - Base Length: 14 in / 35.56 cm
    - Countdown Pieces: Wooden discs (3 mm thick) numbered 1–24, in festive red, green, and yellow colors.
    - The tray compartment provides convenient storage for countdown pieces when not in use.
    📌 Note: The storage box comes flat-packed and requires assembly.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    Designed with UV printing technology, delivering sharp, vivid, and long-lasting colors. The product is printed double-sided, making it visually appealing from every angle.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Works as a countdown advent calendar, helping families and kids mark each day leading up to Christmas or other special occasions.
    - The removable number pieces can be placed on the tree to create a fun and interactive daily activity.
    - Includes a tray holder to store pieces neatly, keeping everything organized.
    - Can be displayed on tables, shelves, mantels, or desks as both a functional calendar and a festive decorative item.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A creative and meaningful gift suitable for Christmas, New Year, birthdays, anniversaries, or seasonal celebrations.
    - Perfect for families, children, teachers, and friends.
    - Combines the joy of a countdown tradition with the charm of holiday décor, making it a thoughtful keepsake for everyone.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Countdown Standing Calendar With Tray

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
